title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - CommunicationInterface
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/CommunicationInterface. A communication interface of a device to a communication network (ttl rdfs:comment). subClassOf s4syst:ConnectionPoint, saref:FeatureOfInterest; restricted to be a connectionPoint of some saref:Device.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CommunicationInterface'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasMACAddress.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/hasMACAddress'. The MAC address of the communication interface. ttl-confirmed, domain CommunicationInterface, subPropertyOf saref:hasIdentifier.

hasIPv4Address.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/hasIPv4Address'. The IPv4 address of the communication interface. ttl-confirmed, domain CommunicationInterface.

hasPortNumber.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/hasPortNumber'. The port number used by the communication interface. ttl-confirmed, domain CommunicationInterface.

interfaceAddress.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/interfaceAddress'. The interface address. The interface may have many addresses like MAC address, IP address or others. Attested in ETSI TS 103 410-8 Table 5 with domain 'Interface'; not found as a declared OWL property in the currently-published saref4ehaw.ttl (dcterms:modified 2025-04-25) -- flagged as a possible ttl/TS synchronisation gap, provisional IRI constructed by namespace pattern. Overlaps in purpose with hasMACAddress/hasIPv4Address above (likely a more generic/later abstraction over the same three granular properties).

transmissionRate.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/TransmissionRate'. The transmission rate of the interface, i.e. the number of bits transmitted per second (usually expressed in kbps or Mbps), in bps. ttl individual, undomained saref:Property; attached here to CommunicationInterface as the best-fitting class.
